references.text: The same chapter further describes how the Levites were consecrated as a wave offering and set apart for service to the Lord
The Levites were cleansed, and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the Lord
The wave offering (tenufah) was used during the consecration of Aaron's sons to the priesthood
Aaron and his sons performed the wave offering during their consecration to the priesthood
The Levites were given to Aaron and his sons to serve in the tabernacle
The Levites were taken from the children of Israel and given as a gift to the Lord to serve at the tent of meeting
The Levites were appointed to perform service at the tabernacle
Describes the service of the Levites at the tent of meeting
